invariants.rationale: The method always returns HoodieWriteMetadata, expected to be non-null to represent successful writing.
Input records to be bulk inserted are usually required and not expected to be null at return.
The instantTime parameter is used for commit time and should be a valid non-empty string.
A non-null HoodieEngineContext is required for any table operation and is assumed at method exit.
The HoodieWriteMetadata should always provide a (possibly empty but not null) list of WriteStatus.
